items.description: Collect the recent underwater hull inspection report for VSL-11 to meet the Newcastle charterer's requirement before arrival, ensuring it is completed within 30 days prior to the laycan of 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-30.
Confirm to the Newcastle charterer that the underwater hull inspection report will be collected and provided before the vessel's arrival during the laycan period of 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-30.
